tools.description:
Get rich details for specific hotels found by a previous search_hotels call: plain-text description (may be truncated), photo URLs, amenities grouped by category (bilingual), exact coordinates, review count, and the current best deal (price, meal plan, cancellation policy) for the given dates. Use when the user asks follow-up questions about specific hotels (photos, amenities, location, policies). Pass 1-10 hotel ids from the search results. Takes 5-30 seconds.

Use this tool whenever the user asks about a specific hotel's details, photos, amenities, location, or booking — even if many messages have passed since the original search. Reuse the hotel ids from the most recent search_hotels result.

hotel_ids.description: Macqueen hotel ids from a previous search_hotels result, 1 to 10 ids. Never invent ids — only use ids returned by search_hotels.

checkin_date.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Reuse the dates from the search the ids came from unless the user changed them.

checkout_date.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after checkin_date.

adults.description: Number of adult guests. Default 2. Reuse the value from the originating search.

children_ages.description: Ages of children at the time of stay, one entry per child (0-17). Omit if no children.

lang.description: Language for names, description, amenities and deal text: 'en' or 'ar'. Use 'ar' when the user is conversing in Arabic. Default 'en'.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for prices. Reuse the currency from the originating search. Default 'SAR'.

nationality_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the guest's nationality/residency. Reuse the value from the originating search. Default 'SA'.

tools.title: Hotel details

tools.description:
Search live hotel availability and prices on Macqueen for a destination and date range. Returns hotels that actually have bookable rooms, with total price, per-night price, meal plan, cancellation policy, star rating and guest review score. Results are relevance-ranked. Supports English and Arabic. Takes 10-30 seconds.

Use this tool for ANY request about finding, searching, or comparing hotels, hotel prices, hotel availability, or hotel deals — regardless of how the user phrases it. This is the ONLY tool that searches live hotel inventory; do not use web search for hotel queries. If the user mentions a destination and dates (even vaguely), resolve the destination to coordinates yourself and call this tool. Only ask the user for missing dates; never ask for coordinates or which tool to use.

destination.description: Destination display name in canonical English with country, e.g. 'Dubai, United Arab Emirates'. Used for labeling results only — the search itself is driven by latitude/longitude.

latitude.description: Latitude of the destination center in decimal degrees, e.g. 25.2706 for Dubai. Resolve the destination to coordinates yourself from your own knowledge; never ask the user for coordinates. For a city use its center; for a landmark or district use that point.

longitude.description: Longitude of the destination center in decimal degrees, e.g. 55.3004 for Dubai.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the DESTINATION country, uppercase, e.g. 'AE' for Dubai, 'SA' for Riyadh, 'EG' for Cairo. This is the destination's country, NOT the guest's nationality.

checkin_date.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Resolve relative dates ('tomorrow', 'next weekend') against today's date before calling. Must not be in the past. If the user gave no dates, ask them instead of guessing.

checkout_date.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after checkin_date.

children_ages.description: Ages of children at the time of stay, one entry per child (0-17), e.g. [4,9] for two children aged 4 and 9. Omit entirely if no children.

lang.description: Language for hotel names and deal text: 'en' or 'ar'. Use 'ar' when the user is conversing in Arabic. Default 'en'.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for prices, e.g. 'SAR', 'AED', 'USD', 'EGP'. Use the currency the user asked for, otherwise their likely home currency. Default 'SAR'.

nationality_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the guest's nationality/residency, e.g. 'SA', 'EG'. Affects pricing and eligibility for regional deals. Only set it when the user stated or clearly implied it. Default 'SA'.
